mapper.select: select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, name, category, quantity, unit, model, energy_type as energyType, remark, data_origin as dataOrigin, source_id as sourceId, sort_order as sortOrder from report_equipment where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} order by sort_order, id
mapper.delete: delete from report_equipment where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.insert: insert into report_equipment ( dept_id, report_id, name, category, quantity, unit, model, energy_type, remark, data_origin, source_id, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{deptId}, #{reportId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{model}, #{energyType}, #{remark}, #{dataOrigin}, #{sourceId}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() )
